name: plainspeak
description: Gamified plain-language communication practice for family medicine residents

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-plainspeak "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-plainspeak --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-plainspeak "vitest run --config functions/vitest.integration.config.ts"
scripts.bootstrap: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/bootstrap.ts
scripts.seed: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/seed-content.ts
